buttons: AppView becomes a simple SynCloudOS app mode controller: grid on launch, editor on memo selection, and a return path that saves before showing all memos.
GridAgent lessons: live search, source counts, a first-slot new memo pad, color cycling from the first memo, and a delete mode that changes commands before touching data.
EditAgent lessons: trim rich text before save, discard empty new memos, delete emptied existing memos, and keep email as an action rather than a storage concern.
DbApi and ServiceWrapper map to local SynCloudOS Persistence for this pass. db8, Luna, PalmServiceBridge, app-services, and sync stay documented follow-ups.
